async def act(page):
    # Select the 'express' template by setting the radio button to checked using set_checked
    await page.get_by_role('radio', name='Use template').nth(2).set_checked(True)
    # Wait for any UI updates after template selection
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Fill in the project name
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name').fill('web_agent_index')
    # Click the 'Create project' button
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Create project').click()
    # Wait for the project creation to complete
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
